calls.title: Salesforce<>GrowthBook - Onboarding
calls.summary: The call focused on onboarding GrowthBook, a feature flag and experimentation platform, for Salesforce’s internal ML platform team. Key pain points included deploying GrowthBook on AWS EKS with DocumentDB, setting up role-based access control (RBAC) with Okta SSO and SCIM, multi-tenancy for multiple teams, and service accounts for API access. Jake Heier and Chris Sanders from GrowthBook joined Harsha Illuri, So-Young Nam, and Ishan from Salesforce (ML platform team). Next steps: Jake to provide an air-gap license key and create a Slack channel for async support; Salesforce to finalize deployment, define
